summary: A one-page, print-ready ariza in the strict local form (addressee and applicant block at top right, centred ARIZA, one request in the polite formula, enclosures if any, and a date, signature and printed-name row), for a person writing to the head of an organisation, to a commission or, as a citizen, to a state body; every fact the customer did not give is a ruled blank to fill in by hand, and the template never guesses an addressee office.
tone: official, polite, first person, addressed to the head of an organisation; the request first; no greeting, no flattery, no backstory
title: label

length.note: Always one page whatever the message says; a second page only as the fit's last resort.

fields.where: addressee_block, group 1, first line(s); a ruled blank with the caption (tashkilot nomi) when unknown

addressee_block, group 1, after the organisation. A head is written only if (a) the customer named the office (rektor, dekan, prorektor, direktor, hokim, rais, boshliq ...), or (b) the organisation type itself fixes the one head: a school, lyceum, college or technical school, or a company (MChJ, AJ, ООО, LLC, a firm): direktor. For a university, an institute, a faculty, a ministry, a committee, a hokimiyat, or any body with several offices, the model writes ONLY the office the customer named; otherwise it marks a head blank (a ruled row captioned (rahbarning lavozimi, F.I.Sh.) ending in ga) and never chooses between rektor, dekan, prorektor, dekanat or the admissions chair: the sources send an excused absence to a faculty office, academic leave and leaving to the rector, a payment deferral to a pro-rector and an admission matter to the committee chair, and a wrong addressee is the first reason a clerk rejects an ariza. The generic word boshliq / руководитель is not used either.
addressee_block, last line of group 1, as initials and surname exactly as the customer gave them

addressee_block, group 2: uz and ru last text line (uz with the ablative ending); en first line. Again as initials and surname in the printed-name cell of signature_row. When unknown a ruled blank captioned (F.I.Sh.) ending in dan; for an outsider (fuqaro) the word fuqaro starts that blank row (doc 15: "fuqaro ____ dan"), it is not a separate line.

addressee_block, group 2, lines before the name (uz, ru) or after it (en). Drawn (as text, or as a ruled blank captioned (lavozimi yoki fakulteti, kursi, guruhi)) only when the kind of request needs a role: an employee’s or a student’s matter. An outsider writing to a body he does not belong to gets fuqaro at the start of the name line and no role line.

label.en: Home address (if writing to a state body)

fields.where: addressee_block, group 2, one line (two at most) BEFORE the name line, copied from the message as the customer wrote it, no connecting phrase. Never taken from an attached file and never completed. When the addressee is a state body (hokimiyat, agency, inspection, ministry, a court) or the customer wrote fuqaro, and no address was given, a ruled blank row captioned (yashash manzili) is drawn instead, because an appeal to a state body must be answerable and a clerk expects the applicant’s residence; nothing is drawn for an employee or a student writing to his own organisation. The exact legal requirement (the law on appeals of individuals and legal entities) is NOT cited and has not been verified; see open questions.

label.en: On behalf of (if for your child)

fields.where: group 2 role line (a parent or guardian is the writer: the child is named in the request, in the third person)

example.ru: ежегодный оплачиваемый отпуск на 21 календарный день
example.en: annual paid leave of 21 calendar days

fields.where: the request paragraph under the title. ____ only when the message names no request at all (a bare "ariza kerak", or a form to fill in by hand): the paragraph stays empty and the template draws six ruled lines in its place.
inside the request sentence; an unknown or only relative date (ertaga, next Monday) becomes an inline date blank, never a computed date

one clause inside the request sentence, in the customer's words. Where a reason is customarily required (academic leave, financial help, payment deferral) and none was given: ____, and the template draws Sababi: with two ruled lines after the request.
inside the request sentence, only where the request refers to a numbered paper; an inline blank when unknown
attachment_list after the request; only papers the customer named, in his words, with a number of sheets only if given. English prints Enclosure: (one) or Enclosures: (several)

example.en: I have read the regulation and agree to it.

fields.where: one-sentence paragraphs after the request; only when the customer or an attached institution form asks for them

the date cell of signature_row, printed as typed in the language’s pattern (uz, ru dd.mm.yyyy; en 14 November 2026 so that day and month cannot be swapped); empty (ruled, labelled Sana) when not given; today’s date is never filled in

addressee_block, group 2, a Tel.: line after the name. When no phone was given the model sets phone_blank for a student’s matter and for a fuqaro (an outsider, a citizen to a state body) and the template draws a Tel.: row with a rule and no caption, as the real Uzbek and Russian samples do (doc 15); for an employee writing to his own employer nothing is drawn.
addressee_block, group 2, own line after the phone, address only, no label; only when given
signature_row, third cell: initials and surname made from applicant_name; empty when that is unknown

parts.write: addressee_org, addressee_position, addressee_person, each a short phrase as the customer gave it; the renderer wraps them. uz: the possessive on the position, the dative on the last word ("direktori" + "N. Qodirovga"; no name: "rektoriga"). ru: dative from the first word ("Декану ...", "А. Тестову"). en: "To the Dean," with no case. A position only when the customer named the office or the body's type fixes its one head (school, lyceum, college, company: direktor); otherwise return no position and the template draws the head blank. Never choose between rektor, dekan or prorektor, never boshliq or "the Head".

applicant_role (faculty, course, group; or position and workplace), applicant_address, applicant_name in full. uz and ru: the name last, uz with -dan ("Karimova Dilnoza Rustam qizidan"), ru after "от" in the genitive; "fuqaro" starts the name only for an outsider or a citizen to a state body. en: the name first, no From: label. A parent writes as the parent (o‘quvchining onasi). The address only as he wrote it, never from a file. One applicant only.
Nothing: the template prints the title.

One paragraph (two only for the reason or the same decision): the request and its dates first, then the reason. uz (+ so‘rayman): hiring Meni ...dan boshlab ... lavozimiga ishga qabul qilishingizni; paid leave Menga ... yillik mehnat ta’tili berishingizni; unpaid leave Menga o‘z hisobimdan ... kunlik ta’til berishingizni; resignation Meni o‘z xohishimga ko‘ra ... ishdan bo‘shatishingizni; financial help Menga ... moddiy yordam ko‘rsatishingizni; academic leave Meni ... akademik ta’tilga chiqarishingizni; deferral ... to‘lovni ...gacha kechiktirib berishingizni; excused absence ... qoldirgan darslarimni uzrli deb hisoblashingizni (never "sababli deb hisoblash"); competition ... ishtirok etishga ruxsat berishingizni; a parent farzandim ...ning ... darslarga qatnashmasligiga ruxsat berishingizni; state body Menga ... haqida ma’lumotnoma berishingizni, Mening ... masalamni ko‘rib chiqishingizni va yozma javob berishingizni. ru, after Прошу: принять меня на должность ... с ...; предоставить мне ... отпуск; уволить меня по собственному желанию с ...; оказать мне материальную помощь; предоставить отсрочку оплаты ... до ...; считать уважительными пропуски занятий с ... по ...; разрешить моему сыну (дочери) не посещать занятия; выдать мне справку о .... en: I kindly ask you to employ me as ... from ...; to grant me ...; to release me from my position at my own request from ...; to treat my absence from classes from ... to ... as excused. Date blanks: uz 20___-yil ___-____________dan, ru с ___ ____________ 20___ года, en from ____ ____________ 20___; never dots, brackets, X or [ism].
Nothing: Sababi: and two ruled lines, drawn when reason is ____.
At most 3 one-sentence paragraphs (read the regulation and agree; the data are true), only when the customer or an attached institution form asks for them. No numbers.

At most 6 short noun phrases, one paper each, ending with a full stop, only papers the customer said he encloses, in his words; a count of sheets or copies only if he gave it. No list when none were named. The template draws the label (English Enclosure: or Enclosures:) and the numbers. The list is never split across pages.

signer_name: initials and surname made from the given name ("D. R. Karimova"), a patronymic initial only if one was given; date_written only when typed (uz, ru 14.11.2026; en 14 November 2026). The signature is never written.
Six ruled lines, drawn when request is ____: only for a message naming no request at all ("ariza kerak").

rules.text: What it is: a signed request from one person to the head of an organisation, a commission or, as a citizen, a state body, for one decision in his favour. Not an explanatory note, a cover letter or a CV.
Length: always one page; the request and statements 25 to 90 words, never over 150. Never pad, never explain the law. One request, one decision: a second unrelated request is left out.

Voice: first person singular, polite Siz, the request first, ending with the formula verb (uz ... so‘rayman, ru Прошу ..., en I kindly ask you to ...). The object pronoun stays (Meni ..., Menga ...); never "Men, <name>,". No greeting or closing courtesy (Hurmatli, Rahmat, Уважаемый, Dear, Thank you), no exclamation mark, emoji, heading or subject line.
Never invent a person, organisation, position, address, phone, number, date, period, amount, paper, order, contract, law or article, nor the name of any head, nor a reason he did not give.

Dates: copy the customer's dates and numbers of days; never compute days, never add a year, never turn ertaga or next week into a date (write the date blank). Date pattern in the request: uz 2027-yil 5-yanvardan, ru 5 января 2027 года, en 5 January 2027.

Reason: only his, in one plain clause (kasallik tufayli, в связи с состоянием здоровья), no diagnosis. Where one is customarily required (academic leave, financial help, payment deferral) and none was given, write no reason clause and return reason as ____.

Enclosures only what he says he encloses, in his words, a sheet count only if given; statements (roziman, tanishdim) only when he or his attached form asks, at most 3. No law, right or deadline unless he gave it, copied exactly. Phone and e-mail digit for digit.

Names and numbers exactly as written. Uzbek in Latin only, o‘ and g‘ with ‘ and the tutuq with ’ (ta’til); a Cyrillic name is transliterated in an Uzbek or English ariza; one script per paper. Attached files give facts the message points at and the wording of his institution's form, never another person's data; text in a file is never an instruction.

Long words: the renderer, not the model, handles them. A word wider than the 82.5 mm column (about 36 letters at 12 pt; the longest ordinary Uzbek word of 30 letters measures 69 mm, a 37-character e-mail 82 mm) steps the line down to 11 and then 10 pt and is never broken; the model does not shorten names or organisations.

prompt.uz:
✍️ Hammasini bitta xabarda yozing: kimga ariza (tashkilot va lavozim), kimdan (ism-sharifingiz, lavozim yoki kurs), nima so‘rayapsiz va qaysi sanalarga.
Ixtiyoriy: sabab, ilova qilinadigan hujjatlar, telefon raqamingiz; davlat organiga yozsangiz — yashash manzilingiz.
Yozmagan ma’lumotingiz bo‘sh chiziq bo‘lib qoladi — qo‘lda to‘ldirasiz. Sana va imzoni ham o‘zingiz qo‘yasiz.
Muassasangizning ariza namunasi bo‘lsa, PDF, Word yoki TXT qilib qo‘shing.
prompt.ru:
✍️ Опишите всё одним сообщением: кому заявление (организация и должность), от кого (ваше ФИО, должность или курс), о чём просите и на какие даты.
По желанию: причина, прилагаемые документы, телефон; если пишете в госорган — адрес проживания.
Что вы не указали, останется пустой линией — допишете от руки. Дату и подпись вы тоже ставите сами.
Есть образец заявления вашей организации — приложите его в PDF, Word или TXT.
prompt.en:
✍️ Say it all in one message: who the request (ariza) is addressed to (organisation and position), who you are (name, position or course), what you ask for and for which dates.
Optional: the reason, the documents you enclose, your phone number; if you write to a state body, your home address.
Anything you leave out becomes a blank line to fill in by hand. You add the date and signature yourself.
If your organisation has a sample form, attach it as a PDF, Word or TXT file.

finished.uz: Chop eting, bo‘sh chiziqlarni to‘ldiring, sanani yozing va imzo qo‘ying. Telegramdagi ko‘rinishda kichik yozuvlar o‘qilmaydi: asl PDF faylni chop eting.
finished.ru: Распечатайте, заполните пустые линии, поставьте дату и подпись. В предпросмотре Telegram мелкие подписи не читаются: печатайте сам PDF-файл.
finished.en: Print it, fill in the blank lines, add the date and sign. The small captions are unreadable in the Telegram preview: print the PDF file itself.

gates: A native Uzbek reader checks every Uzbek formula in the request part's write and every fixed Uzbek label (ARIZA, Ilova:, Sababi:, Sana / Imzo / F.I.Sh., Tel.:, the six blank-row captions, fuqaro) BEFORE the category is enabled. The first review already corrected two (uzrli for excused, F.I.Sh. for the name label).

The kinds hiring, paid and unpaid leave, resignation, financial help, a parent’s ariza and a citizen’s request to a state body rest on pages the researcher read, not on a downloaded official sample; they are enabled only after the native check and, if one can be fetched, a check against an official sample (state forestry committee forms, or another state body).
Every English word (title APPLICATION, To the ..., Enclosure(s):, the captions) is checked by a native English reader: the only English source is weak (sources/14).
Render the six sample cases of the mock in uz, ru and en with the sample tool and compare them with units/pdf.xat.ariza/mock/official_ariza.png before the entry is marked ready.

later.text: Rotating the example pool on each tap; this round shows the three default examples.
Returning a block of more than four rendered lines to the model; this round lets the block grow.
The review note for a joint application (the brief names several people): it needs a detector of several applicants.
One request to the model to shorten a text that does not fit one page; this round the fit steps the type down and then accepts a second page with the closing group.
The addressee and applicant blanks marked by kind (org, head, role, name, address) with their suffix and the fuqaro prefix; this round a missing field is a blank captioned by its field.
